# Convert a BAI2 bank file to OFX, QBO, QIF or a Xero CSV

> Free BAI2 converter: check the file's control totals and balances, then download OFX/QBO for QuickBooks and Quicken, QIF, or a Xero statement CSV, with stable transaction IDs. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
